</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Necromancy Talents</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ These are separated into tiers.
    • Tier unlocks require reaching soul checkpoints.
    • Some unlocks require completing quests.
⬥ Talent points are required for each unlock 
    • These are unlocked by training necromancy through combat.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talents Tier 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Requires 1 soul and completion of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (with 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talents Tier 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Requires 50 souls
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talents Tier 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Requires 400 souls
    • Completion of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mythos <nowiki>Rune Mythos</nowiki>]<nowiki> is required for all incantations.
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1" alt="conjureghost" title="conjureghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1" alt="conjurezombie" title="conjurezombie" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talents Tier 4</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Requires 2000 souls
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe" title="spectralscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809156678631484.png?v=1" alt="spiritpact1" title="spiritpact1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809191231295549.png?v=1" alt="commandzombie" title="commandzombie" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talents Tier 5</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Requires 4500 souls
    • Incantations in tier 5 and 6 require </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock <nowiki>Tomes of the Warlock</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe2" title="spectralscythe2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1280109199069806604.png?v=1" alt="conjurephantom" title="conjurephantom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809162022166528.png?v=1" alt="spiritpact2" title="spiritpact2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
